universe_notes: U is the set of statements in BaseLoader.load that can supply the local 'code' consumed by Template.from_code.

Completeness outside these statements is not claimed.

inputs.note: A legal user-supplied BytecodeCache returns code compiled from different source. P+ renders the cached value, P- recompiles the actual template.
The cache returns code compiled from the same source. P+ and P- render identically; disabling the compile fallback exposes the missing cache read.
